name: EPIC 206008070
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 8.2 solar radii and 0.83 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206008070 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM radius (solar radii) 8.179123 (16th-84th percentiles 7.971932-8.481452), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206008070 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.825168 (16th-84th percentiles 0.77673-0.899655), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206008070: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4818.568 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206008070 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3478.4375 (16th-84th percentiles 3403.398438-3573.554688), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.03 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 3,478 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.83 solar masses and 8.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,819 K at its surface.
